# Camplify

> Summer camp management software for camp directors and administrators.

Camplify (https://camplify.app) is a web-based camp management platform built by Camplify LLC. It helps summer camps, day camps, and overnight camps manage scheduling, housing, staff, campers, and daily operations in one place.

## What Camplify does

- Auto-schedules camp activities and programs (cabin-based or camper-choice modes)
- Manages activities with time blocks, locations, staff, and capacity
- Manages housing and cabin assignments
- Tracks staff availability, certifications, and schedules
- Handles camper records, group assignments, and allergy/dietary visibility so staff know who's coming, where they are, and what they need
- Tracks vehicle and driver assignments so camps can run a leaner fleet
- Provides dashboards, calendar export, and daily operations tools

## Who it's for

Camp directors, administrators, and operations staff at day camps and overnight summer camps in the United States and internationally.

## Brand note

Camplify (camplify.app) is summer camp management software. It is not related to camplify.com.au (RV rental) or camplify.com.sg (Singapore kids' camps).
